title: Kaggriculture Self-Training DQN Agent
subtitle: Self-play reinforcement learning and behavior cloning model artifacts for Kaggriculture.
description:
# Model Summary

Trained PyTorch DQN model and checkpoint artifacts for Kaggriculture reinforcement learning self-play.

## Architecture

Deep Q-Network (DQN) with kinematic phase gating, behavior cloning pre-training, and self-play replay buffer.

## Artifacts Included

- `models/model.pth`: Exported PyTorch model weights
- `checkpoints/`: Training state checkpoint (`training_state_latest.pt`)
- `agent.py`: Submission agent adapter
- `config.json`: Complete experiment hyperparameter configuration
- `metrics/`: Win rate, ladder evaluation, training progress, and episode metrics
- `plots/`: Loss, epsilon decay, buffer size, reward, and win-rate curves
- `logs/`: Training run logs
